subtitle: THE LIVING MACHINE
finish_first: Finish this wave before starting a new run.
spark_desc: Arcs hit nearby enemies. Resin-coated enemies conduct to neighbors. Rain enables chaining without resin.
oil_desc: Coats and slows an enemy. Combine with a burner for an explosion, or a coil for chain lightning.
flame_desc: Burns enemies over time. Hitting resin detonates a blast around the target.
shifter_desc: Hits and pushes an enemy into the next lane. Funnel enemies into another machine's reach.
collector_desc: Catch a thrown enemy to make a living machine. Feed it another enemy before the hunger bar empties. Same species grows; different species mutates. A starving captive breaks out inside your defenses.
upgrade_hint: Click a machine to upgrade (5 / 7). Drag it to move for free, keeping its creature. Right-click to sell (creature lost).
build_hint: Your magnet can turn enemies into living machines. Start the wave, then DRAG the resin-coated enemy into the magnet or into the crowd. Click equipment to add or upgrade.
fight_hint: DRAG an enemy into another lane! Throw burning enemies into crowds or feed them to magnets. Q/W/E: pulse. Dispatch courier in the first 5 seconds.
reward_hint: Choose one recovered upgrade on the right to continue.
win_hint: Eight waves survived. Try a new seed and a different machine combination.
loss_hint: Rebuild a different combination. New run is at the top right.
unavailable: Cannot do that now. Check scrap, phase or machine level.
marked: Moment recorded with exact world state.
reward_range_desc: Arc coils and burners reach farther.
reward_salvage_desc: Every defeated enemy yields another scrap.
reward_repair_desc: Restore up to seven hull points and gain four scrap.
grid_hint: LEFT: hull   /   RIGHT: incoming   •   Click to place · Right-click to repack
inversion_law: Pulses PULL enemies toward your hull. Machines deal double damage within the leftmost 2.5 cells.
debt_law: Pulses push twice as far, but each use schedules two additional enemies later.
relay_law: Deflectors spread the redirected enemy's resin and fire to enemies in the destination lane.
courier_lost: Courier lost. Cargo could not be recovered.
partial_cargo: Early scrap secured. Recall now or continue deeper.
rescued_engineer: Sera rescued! All machines cycle faster.
rescued_medic: Mora rescued! Successful extractions repair hull.
found_inversion: Inverted Heart recovered. Equip between waves.
found_debt: Borrowed Tomorrow recovered. Equip between waves.
found_relay: Contagion Ring recovered. Equip between waves.
debt_borrowed: Borrowed power. Two enemies added to your debt.
grafted_runner: Living machine: captured runner now fires from its magnet.
grafted_sprinter: Living machine: captured sprinter accelerates nearby devices!
grafted_armored: Living machine: captured armor blocks the next breach here.
grafted_brute: Living machine: captured brute powers an area discharge!
grabbed: Magnetic grip engaged. Aim, then release.
trait_runner_desc: Catch this creature in a magnet to make a living turret. It fires at nearby enemies in its lane.
trait_sprinter_desc: Catch it in a magnet to halve the attack interval of machines within two cells on that lane.
trait_armored_desc: Catch it in a magnet to block one breach in its lane. Throwing also cracks its armor, making it easier to kill.
trait_brute_desc: Catch it in a magnet to power a recurring area discharge. Throwing it into a crowd deals heavy collision damage.
drag_hint: Drag to a landing point. Release to bowl rightward. A magnet captures it alive and replaces its previous trait.
machine_moved: Machine moved with its living trait intact.
feeding_hint: Throw another creature into this machine. Same species: grow (max 3). Different species: mutate. Hunger reaching zero releases it inside your defenses.
creature_hungry: A living machine is hungry. Feed it before it breaks out!
creature_escaped: Your captive broke out INSIDE the defenses!
creature_fed: Fed and grown! The living machine is stronger.
